question: Under complete fresh current-policy rectangles, does the directly identity-proved exact one-back intent-history producer have robust payoff-capable natural activation, exact-inactive controls, viable activation and more than one authored Attack and enemy-move identity without changing path, RNG or result?
hypothesis: Current Dusk policies naturally meet an exact repeated-intent telegraph with a legal exact-target authored Attack before that enemy acts often enough to support one later equal-cohort CRN first look, while a substantial exact-inactive policy set preserves causal contrast.
claimBoundary: Fresh-cohort existing-policy intent-history producer opportunity, payoff-capable natural response capacity, exact-inactive controls, viability, card breadth and move breadth only. The payoff is disabled and no causal effect, endpoint, policy control, complementarity, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim is estimated.

scientificBasis.entryGate: The fixed source/interface/direct A/B/AB preflight completed 113 of 113 observations with zero faults and froze only repeat-one-back-exact-target-Attack-deferred-Ember-one for natural capacity.
scientificBasis.observationalArm: Producer=true and consumer=false is the directly proved non-perturbing A-only instrument. It observes exact repeated-intent windows and the first qualifying response disposition but cannot grant Ember or change policy state.
scientificBasis.capacityBoundary: Only a consumer-disabled exact-target Attack whose own ordinary discard or exhaust settlement completes before victory or defeat is payoff-capable. A response that makes combat terminal is exposure evidence but cannot reach the frozen deferred consumer.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: The complete 64-policy by four-seed rectangle, thresholds, metrics, source, identity comparator and stop rule are fixed before any whole-run row. No encounter, move, card, policy, seed or outcome subset exists.

intentHistoryPayoff.fixed: The directly proved deferred Ember-one consumer is disabled in both arms; no payoff level is varied.

producerObservation.meaning: The candidate arm emits research telemetry when a living Dusk enemy's non-empty exact current move equals exact one-back, stores only {move, createdTurn} in that enemy's existing flags and records exact expiry or response disposition.
producerObservation.pathConstraint: After removing intent-history research telemetry and probe labels, every candidate row must exactly equal its current-main pair, including policy snapshot, fights, outcome, deck, relics, economy, final RNG and all existing package metrics.

scorelinePayoff.fixed: Separate immutable causal factor; absent and not pooled.

afterimagePayoff.fixed: Separate immutable causal factor; absent and not pooled.

acquisitionPriority.fixed: Exact same sampled policy identity in each pair; no acquisition control.

design.type: Two-arm paired non-causal natural-capacity observation; not a factorial and not an endpoint experiment.

anchors.currentMain: The unmodified baseline worktree at c4130163 is the sole outcome and RNG anchor.
anchors.directIdentity: The immutable intent-history direct A/B/AB result 6367b4c3 is the source, null, mediator, lifecycle and deferred-payoff anchor.
anchors.closedFamilies: Archive head 843e899, exact-lethal capacity closure 6f826f60, positive-overkill closure 8e014d8d, cross-turn closure dbfccbae and every earlier valid family disposition are immutable and cannot be reopened or pooled.

design.pairing: Every arm uses policyRoot 562, policy indices 0 through 63, seeds 346634 through 346637, Duskblade, Vow 5, current content, current policy resolver, baseline, simulator and estimator in identical policy-major/seed-minor order.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Exact repeated-intent producer by response settlement: consumer-disabled responses settling before terminal are payoff-capable; terminal responses and unresolved stall markers are measured separately.
Exact repeated-intent producer by authored Attack identity: exact card counters test whether natural capacity is broader than one card without making card identity a factor or subset.
Exact repeated-intent producer by enemy move identity: exact move counters test whether capacity is broader than one authored move without selecting an encounter or move.
Policy identity by simulation seed: a policy is robust-active only when payoff-capable activation occurs in at least two of its four fixed seeds.
design.aliasStructure: Producer windows are not payoff-capable unless the current policy supplies a legal exact-target authored Attack in that same telegraph window and its settlement completes before terminal. Final responses, unanswered expiry, target death, victory, defeat and stall residuals remain separate. Exact one-back equality is not a generic INTENT, two-back return, damaging-intent subset, Stagger event, target switch, next-PLAY tag or terminal-hit event. Scoreline, Afterimage, terminal-hit precision/excess, cross-turn hold, Shatter, draw, duplicate and reshuffle families remain absent or closed.
design.omittedCells: No AB payoff arm, off-versus-on endpoint, policy control, encounter, move or card subset, Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Ward setup, protected seed, held-out row, ML, RL or optimiser.

cohort.identity: Fresh and disjoint from every frozen #421 whole-run cohort. Each of 64 deterministic policy identities is evaluated on all four seeds in both arms; no identity may be selected, removed, replaced or added.
cohort.freshnessAudit: A pre-freeze exact search found no policyRoot 562 and no seeds 346634 through 346637 in existing protocols, summaries or the 482036-row append-only ledger. Incidental hash substrings and source line numbers were excluded.

estimands.unit: Policy identity over its complete four-seed rectangle.
estimands.exposureActive: Producer windows occur in at least two of four rows, including terminal responses and unresolved stall residuals.
estimands.active: At least one payoff-capable settled response occurs in at least two of four rows.
estimands.exactInactive: Zero payoff-capable settled responses in all four rows.
estimands.ambiguous: Payoff-capable activation in exactly one of four rows; reported and never promoted or subsetted.
estimands.viable: An active policy has at least one payoff-capable row whose unchanged current-main outcome is win.
estimands.cardBreadth: Number and complete counts of distinct authored Attack ids associated with payoff-capable settlement; no card subset is selected.
estimands.moveBreadth: Number and complete counts of distinct exact repeated enemy move ids associated with payoff-capable settlement; no move or encounter subset is selected.
estimands.identity: Zero canonical mismatches between each current-main row and its A-only row after removing only probe labels and intent-history research counters.
estimands.attribution: For every row, producer equals mediator-set and producer partitions into expiry plus residual markers; consumer-disabled expiry partitions into payoff-capable settled and terminal responses; exact card and move counters each sum to payoff-capable responses; AI-boundary key faults, telemetry faults, consumer, mediator-consume, payoff, requested and realised remain zero.
estimands.notEstimated: Payoff effect, outcome delta, policy-control value, move or card effect, cross-package interaction, balance, product value, acceptance or protected confirmation.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/exposure, eight viable, two-of-four robustness and one baseline-fault limits reuse the frozen 64-policy structural-capacity scale. Two eligible card and two eligible move identities are the smallest pre-support breadth gates that reject a single-card or single-move alias without selecting a subset.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns complete cohort construction, two content-addressed plans, process execution, exact paired comparison, telemetry attribution, policy aggregation and stop/go. Deterministic GDScript owns unchanged simulation and direct event harvesting.
executionAndStopping.order: Verify immutable evidence, refs, source, Godot and ledger; pass source/cardinality gates; execute all 256 current-main rows once; execute all 256 A-only rows once; analyse the sole complete look; verify byte-identical ledger.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 512 observations are the only look. No source, row, policy, seed, gate, metric, threshold, subset or cap changes after execution begins.
executionAndStopping.successStop: All fixed gates pass: stop and separately preregister the smallest off-versus-AB CRN first look using these exact policy and seed identities.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Any completed immutable, identity, attribution, reliability, active, inactive, viable, exposure or breadth gate fails: close intent history without repair and continue serially to zero-row private counter/tag/transform inside #421.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: A frozen input or fixed process is unavailable, a process is incomplete, or the exact decision is unavailable at 120 seconds: record inconclusive without rerun.
executionAndStopping.futureCrnConstraint: Any later causal arms use these same frozen policy identities, simulation seed identities, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule across every compared level.
executionAndStopping.methodConstraint: No policy control, ML, RL or optimiser is authorised by this capacity screen.

decisionRules.success: All immutable, source, exact identity, attribution and reliability gates pass; at least 16 policies are robust-active, 16 exact-inactive, eight viable, 16 exposure-active, two distinct eligible Attack ids and two distinct eligible move ids are observed; all 512 rows complete within 120 seconds; ledger is byte-identical.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only repeat-one-back-exact-target-Attack-deferred-Ember-one and preregister the smallest equal-cohort off-versus-AB CRN first look using these exact current policy identities. Do not add a policy control, joint package, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Inputs and observations complete, but any identity, attribution, reliability, active, inactive, viable, exposure, card-breadth or move-breadth gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close intent history without encounter, move, card, policy, cohort, payoff or method rescue; continue serially with zero-row private counter/tag/transform design inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input or process is unavailable, a process is incomplete, or the exact decision is unavailable at the 120-second cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record intent-history capacity inconclusive at the preregistered cap. Do not rerun, alter the cohort, change a gate, use protected seeds or create a routine human checkpoint.

forbidden: any causal payoff or endpoint claim from producer-only telemetry
any encounter, move, card, policy, seed, outcome or support subset
any Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Ward setup or closed-family variation
any repair, rerun, reserve row or adaptive continuation after a completed failure
any append to the research ledger
any protected acceptance or reserve seed
any policy control, ML, RL or optimiser
